assignments.title: Model Quality & Information Review
assignments.competencyObjective: Inspect model structure and information consistency, identify production-readiness risks, and recommend corrective action.
assignments.context: Use an approved sanitized or synthetic training model locally. Native model files remain outside BCL evidence upload.
assignments.instructions: Review the assigned model against the provided QA/QC checklist. Document model structure, naming, levels/grids, parameters, completeness, information consistency, drawing/QTO readiness, critical findings, and corrective recommendations.
expectedWorkflow: Confirm the case scope and review checklist.
Inspect model structure, naming, levels/grids, and key parameters.
Record findings with severity and reproducible evidence.
Assess drawing and QTO readiness.
Prioritize corrective recommendations and prepare the review package.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF model-quality review report plus XLSX/CSV checklist and optional annotated PNG/JPG screenshots.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: Accepted means the review is technically coherent, findings are traceable and prioritized, and no critical QA/QC issue is left unexplained.
dependencies: Local access to an approved model-viewing/authoring tool

caseData.executionContract: Provide one non-confidential training model with known structure and information-quality issues plus a review checklist.

assignments.title: Federated Model Coordination & Clash Review
assignments.competencyObjective: Review federated discipline alignment, classify coordination issues, assign priorities/ownership recommendations, and communicate a recheck workflow.
assignments.context: Perform federation and clash work locally with an approved ARS/STR/MEP exercise set; submit only derived reports, logs, and screenshots.
assignments.instructions: Verify alignment of the supplied discipline models, run or review clash tests, classify and prioritize material issues, propose responsible discipline/owner and resolution action, explain revision/recheck logic, and produce a structured coordination report.
expectedWorkflow: Verify discipline files, coordinates, units, and alignment assumptions.
Define clash-test scope and tolerances supplied by the exercise.
Identify, group, classify, and prioritize coordination issues.
Recommend ownership and resolution actions.
Document recheck status and issue traceability.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF coordination report plus XLSX/CSV clash/issue log and representative PNG/JPG screenshots.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: Accepted means setup assumptions are explicit, significant issues are correctly classified and traceable, and proposed coordination actions are technically usable.

caseData.executionContract: Provide aligned non-confidential discipline models containing a known set of coordination issues and an approved clash-test brief.

assignments.title: 4D Model-Schedule Linkage
assignments.competencyObjective: Translate a WBS/activity structure into model grouping and a coherent model-schedule linkage, then evaluate sequence and data issues.
assignments.context: Use a mentor-approved synthetic model/WBS exercise locally. Video upload is not required; evidence is a report, mapping table, and sequence screenshots.
assignments.instructions: Interpret the supplied WBS, define model breakdown/selection groups, map groups to activities, review sequence logic, identify linkage/data problems, and document corrections and assumptions.
expectedWorkflow: Review WBS, activity IDs, dates, and sequencing assumptions.
Define model breakdown and selection/grouping rules.
Create and validate the model-to-activity mapping table.
Review key sequence states and identify linkage/data problems.
Document assumptions, findings, and corrections.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF 4D workflow report, XLSX/CSV model-activity mapping table, and PNG/JPG sequence screenshots.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: Accepted means WBS interpretation, model grouping, activity mapping, and sequence reasoning are coherent and supported by traceable evidence.
dependencies: Approved synthetic model and schedule exercise

caseData.executionContract: Provide a non-confidential model breakdown and schedule containing stable activity IDs, dates, dependencies, and deliberate mapping issues.

assignments.title: QTO / 5D Validation
assignments.competencyObjective: Extract quantities, validate model/category/parameter readiness, reconcile against a supplied reference, and explain material discrepancies.
assignments.context: Use an approved synthetic or sanitized quantity case locally; submit tabular extracts and methodology/reconciliation evidence only.
assignments.instructions: Check model readiness for the selected quantity scope, extract quantities, compare them with the supplied manual/BOQ/reference quantities, analyze discrepancies, reconcile justified differences, and document reliability limitations.
expectedWorkflow: Confirm measurement scope, categories, units, and reference basis.
Check model parameters and object classification used for extraction.
Produce a controlled quantity extract.
Compare and reconcile against the supplied reference quantity.
Explain discrepancies, assumptions, and reliability limits.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: XLSX/CSV quantity extract and reconciliation plus PDF methodology/discrepancy report with optional PNG/JPG screenshots.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: Accepted means extraction is reproducible, validation method is appropriate, discrepancies are reasoned rather than hidden, and no critical reliability concern is unresolved.
dependencies: Approved quantity case and reference quantity

caseData.executionContract: Provide a non-confidential model quantity scope and reference table containing known reconciliations and discrepancies.

assignments.title: Automation / Digital Workflow Improvement
assignments.competencyObjective: Identify a repetitive BIM/data task, design and test a practical improvement, measure its benefit, and document limitations.
assignments.context: Source code or executable artifacts are not uploaded. The participant may prototype locally and submit derived reports, screenshots, and outputs.
assignments.instructions: Describe the current manual workflow, define an improvement hypothesis, build or simulate a controlled automation/data workflow, validate output against a baseline, measure practical effect, and document limitations and safe-use boundaries.
expectedWorkflow: Define the repetitive problem and baseline workflow.
Design a controlled improvement and validation method.
Prototype or simulate the workflow locally.
Compare output with the baseline and record errors/limitations.
Document benefit, constraints, and recommended next action.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF/DOCX technical report plus CSV/XLSX outputs and PNG/JPG before/after evidence; no source-code upload.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: If undertaken, a mentor accepts only a demonstrably useful, validated workflow with explicit limitations; no numeric threshold auto-accepts it.

caseData.executionContract: Mentor approves one non-confidential repetitive workflow and baseline dataset before work starts.

assignments.title: BIM Documentation / Delivery Package
assignments.competencyObjective: Assemble a traceable BIM delivery package with controlled naming/status, revision and issue records, consistency checks, and handover notes.
assignments.context: Use derived outputs from an approved exercise; do not expose internal storage locations or production project files.
assignments.instructions: Organize a delivery register, verify model/report/drawing consistency, record revision and issue status, apply naming/status logic, document CDE/handover assumptions, and produce a concise quality summary.
expectedWorkflow: Define delivery scope, naming/status rules, and information authority.
Build the deliverable and revision register.
Check consistency across model-derived reports, drawings, and issue records.
Record open issues, approvals, and handover assumptions.
Prepare the controlled delivery package summary.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF/DOCX delivery narrative plus XLSX/CSV deliverable/revision/issue register.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: Accepted means the package is structured, internally consistent, traceable, and clear about status, revisions, open issues, and handover assumptions.
dependencies: Mentor-approved delivery register template or required fields

caseData.executionContract: Provide non-confidential derived outputs and a delivery scenario with revisions, issue states, and handover requirements.

assignments.title: Capstone / Improvement Project
assignments.context: No approved case, scope, prerequisite bundle, or governance currently exists.
dependencies: Future scope, case, mentor capacity, and rubric approval
